card.name: Inside chemical substituent names
card.fires_on: Partway through chemical names where a position prefix like N-, O-, or C-17 is followed by a substituent group such as desmethyl, demethylation, or alkylated. It marks the spot where a group is removed, added or swapped.

modes.description: Pieces such as odes, -des or -dem inside N- or O-demethylated metabolite names.
